assumptions.note: Inputs are anchored where a licence allows and stated otherwise: risk_free_rate is the U.S. Treasury par yield on each note's pricing date interpolated to its maturity; vol is the 30-day implied-vol index close (VIX/VXN/RVX) on the pricing date as the grid centre for index underlyings (single stocks and others keep stated 0.25); correlation is the average realised pairwise correlation from cached FRED closes where both legs exist, else stated 0.6 (0 for one underlying); credit_spread 0.006, dividend 0.01 and erp 0.05 stay stated. The per-note market_inputs record states every source and date, including anything missing or not anchored. Anchored vols use a relative band (centre x (1 ± 0.15): implied vol observed on the pricing date; ±15% relative band); unanchored vols keep the wider absolute band. The bank's estimated value never chooses the band.
